title: Pertinaciousness
summary: PERTINA'CIOUSNESS PERTINAC'ITY, noun [Latin pertinacia.] Firm or unyielding adherence to opinion or purpose; obstinacy. He pursues his scheme with pertinacity. 1. Resolution; constancy.
